title: QUIC RFC 9000 Weakly Protected Packet Failure Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P2 requirement-home tests over Initial and Handshake packet-protection open failure, forbidden weakly protected payload connection-error generation, and pre-validation side-effect rollback, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the remaining S5P2 weak-protection failure-policy tail after the endpoint packet classification and association floor.
expected_result: The focused tests show Initial and Handshake packet-protection open failures are discarded once keys are available, Handshake open failures are not deferred for retry when current keys apply, forbidden weakly protected payload frames generate PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, and pre-validation prevents crypto-buffer or transcript side effects from surviving those invalid packets.
procedure: Run the focused S5P2 tail requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The packet classification and association floor under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0072 remains closed.
Initial and Handshake packet frame allowance remains aligned with RFC 9000 Section 12.4 requirement homes.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim broader packet-protection cryptographic correctness, Retry integrity validation changes, Version Negotiation behavior changes, public API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S5P2 weak-protection tail filter passed 7/7, the focused S5P2 plus S11/S17 regression guard passed 9/9, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0010, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0012, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0013 trace_clean and reports 1,286 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 463 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,522/4,522, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
